item.title: In a Toy Shop
item.description: Name toys on a shelf, ask to see one, and describe how toys move.

children.definition: A soft toy that looks like a bear.
children.example: Can I see the brown teddy bear on the top shelf?

children.definition: A toy that looks like a person, often a baby.
children.example: Can I see the doll in the blue dress?

children.definition: A round toy you can throw or kick.
children.example: Is this ball soft enough to use indoors?

children.definition: A small piece of wood with flat sides that you can put together with other pieces to make things.
children.example: Can I put this wooden block on top of the red one?
collocations: a wooden block with a letter on it

children.definition: A thin bag that gets bigger when you blow air into it or fill it with another gas.
children.example: Can you blow up a yellow balloon for me, please?

children.definition: A light toy that goes up in the air on a windy day while you hold its string.
children.example: Does this kite come with a long string?
collocations: a kite with a long tail

children.definition: A small train for playing, often with its own little track.
children.example: Can I see the toy train go around the track?
collocations: a toy train with three cars

children.definition: A game where you fit small pieces together to make a picture.
children.example: I'd like the jigsaw puzzle with the picture of a farm.

children.definition: A small toy with two round sides that goes down and up on a string.
children.example: Can you show me how to use this yo-yo?
Could you show me the toys on the top shelf, please?
collocations: show a toy to a child

children.definition: To move on a surface by turning over and over.
children.example: This ball can roll across the shop floor.

children.definition: To move away from a surface after hitting it.
children.example: Does that little ball bounce high?
The picture on the box shows how high the kite can fly.

children.definition: To make something by putting pieces together.
children.example: Can I build a little house with the blocks in this set?
